# llms.txt — LLM-Readable Project Description

> Context for models working on this codebase.

## Project

The Pride of Tirumala (TPT) Apartment Expense Tracker — a Progressive Web App for apartment maintenance finances.

## Stack

- React 19 + Vite 8
- Google Sheets API v4 (database — no backend)
- Google Drive API v3 (receipts, backups, activity funds)
- Google Identity Services (OAuth 2.0)
- jsPDF
- Tesseract.js v5 `eng` (on-device OCR)
- Web Speech API
- vite-plugin-pwa
- Vitest
- Vanilla CSS
- Lucide React
- HashRouter

## Purpose

Track monthly maintenance (₹3,000 × 10 flats) from **Sep 2026**, log expenses, generate PDFs that show surplus/deficit/available balance. Opening surplus is **₹612**.

**The Google Sheet is the source of truth.** Adding a row on Maintenance or Expenses and refreshing the app must show that change.

## Society workbook (critical)

There is **one** workbook: `APP-TPT-Tracker` in Drive folder `TPT-APP-Tracker`.

- Founding owner may **create** it if Drive search finds none
- If it already exists, Setup connects it (backup first when reconnecting)
- Do not create `TPT-MaintenanceTracker`, `The Pride of Tirumala-APP`, or a LIVE twin
- Balance tab formulas: opening 612 + collected − spent = available; SURPLUS / DEFICIT / BALANCED
- Monthly Summary formulas: per month collected, spent, month result, running balance, status
- First month label: `Sep-26`
- `public/sheet-config.json` may list a published id after create. Do not invent one in source
- Payees: GPay/PhonePe `number@ybl`; optional UPI overrides. Duplicates rejected
- Expenses with same date + description + amount are rejected
- Maintenance Record Payment defaults to PAID; several flats at once; no late fee

## Access model (critical)

- Founding owner email: `th***@gmail.com` (full value only in `src/config/accessPolicy.js`)
- Only that account may create/connect `APP-TPT-Tracker` and grant Owner
- New users default to Reader
- Drive share: Viewer for Reader, Writer for Owner
- Founding owner cannot be removed
- Max 20 users, max 2 Owners
- Members discover via `sharedWithMe` plus optional `sheet-config.json`
- Writes use `withWriteAuth`
- Private copies owned by a non-founder are ignored

Policy helpers live in `src/config/accessPolicy.js`.

## Key files

- `src/config/accessPolicy.js`
- `src/config/constants.js` — `DRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER`, `SHEET_FILE_NAME`, `OPENING_SURPLUS`, `FIRST_APP_MONTH_LABEL`
- `src/utils/ledgerMath.js` — opening + collected − spent
- `src/utils/months.js` — Sep-26 sequence
- `src/utils/workbookCsv.js` — local CSV workbook for tests
- `src/services/sheetSetup.js` — create/connect + formulas
- `src/services/sheetFormulas.js`
- `src/services/googleSheets.js`
- `src/services/googleDrive.js`
- `src/services/pdfExport.js`
- `Architecture.md`

## Constraints

- 10 flats: 101, 102, 201, 202, 301, 302, 401, 402, 501, 502
- No backend. Deployable to GitHub Pages (`/AppartmentApp/`) and Azure SWA
- Indian Rupee. PDFs mask emails and phones
- Mobile: hamburger + bottom nav, 44px targets
- Do not hardcode owner names into JS source

## Deployment

- Push to `main` → GitHub Actions Pages
- After create, optionally paste the sheet id into `public/sheet-config.json`
- Hard-refresh or Settings → Clear cache after deploy (PWA `tpt-v50`)
